description: Simulation environment configuration for AI Mayor City Sim (Milestone 1)
assumptions_documented: Budget of $100,000 is renewed each monthly step (unspent funds do not roll over).
Each neighborhood allocation is partitioned into service backlog (80%) and traffic safety (20%).
Safety risk improvements depend strictly on safety-designated funds, not total neighborhood allocation.
Incoming backlogs and safety drift model monthly service demand and infrastructure wear.
Reward function normalizes backlog reduction against initial backlog, safety reduction across areas, and penalizes inequality using the Gini coefficient.
Simulated outcomes do not establish real-world causality.
